shloka_text: स तु तत्र दशग्रीवः सह सैन्येन वीर्यवान् । अस्तं प्राप्ते दिनकरे निवासं समरोचयत् ।। 7.26.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tatra daśagrīvaḥ saha sainyena vīryavān | astaṃ prāpte dinakare nivāsaṃ samarocayat || 7.26.1 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, तत्र there, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), सह with, सैन्येन his army, वीर्यवान् the powerful one, अस्तम् setting, प्राप्ते having reached, दिनकरे the sun, निवासम् residence, समरोचयत् chose.
explanation: There, the powerful Ravana, along with his army, chose to reside as the sun was setting.
comments: Encamped at Kailasa on a moonlit, spring-laden night, the lust-struck Ravana seizes the apsara Rambha, who pleads that she is his daughter-in-law, betrothed to Kubera's son Nalakubara -- he violates her nonetheless -- told of the outrage, Nalakubara curses that if Ravana ever forces an unwilling woman his head shall split into seven pieces, and the gods rejoice, for the curse will one day shield Sita.

shloka_text: उदिते विमले चन्द्रे तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि । प्रसुप्तं सुमहत्सैन्यं नानाप्रहरणायुधम् ।। 7.26.2 ।।
transliteration: udite vimale candre tulyaparvatavarcasi | prasuptaṃ sumahatsainyaṃ nānāpraharaṇāyudham || 7.26.2 ||
translation: उदिते having risen, विमले pure, चन्द्रे the moon, तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि having splendor equal to a mountain, प्रसुप्तं sleeping, सुमहत्सैन्यं a very large army, नानाप्रहरणायुधम् with various weapons and arms.
explanation: As the pure moon, shining with the brilliance of a mountain, rose, a vast army equipped with diverse weapons lay asleep.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि । स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् ।। 7.26.3 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryo niṣaṇṇaḥ śailamūrdhani | sa dadarśa guṇāṃstatra candrapādapaśobhitān || 7.26.3 ||
translation: रावणस्तु but Ravana, महावीर्यो very powerful, निषण्णः seated, शैलमूर्धनि on the mountain peak, सः he, ददर्श saw, गुणांस्तत्र the beauties there, चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् adorned by moonlit trees.
explanation: But the mighty Ravana, seated on the mountain peak, beheld the beautiful features of that place, enhanced by trees illuminated by the moonlight.

shloka_text: कर्णिकारवनैर्दीप्तैः कदम्बगहनैस्तथा । पद्मिनीभिश्च फुल्लाभिर्मन्दाकिन्या जलैरपि ।। 7.26.4 ।।
transliteration: karṇikāravanairdīptaiḥ kadambagahanaistathā | padminībhiśca phullābhirmandākinyā jalairapi || 7.26.4 ||
translation: कर्णिकारवनैः by forests of Karnikara trees, दीप्तैः shining, कदम्बगहनैः by dense Kadamba groves, तथा and also, पद्मिनीभिश्च and by lotus ponds, फुल्लाभिः full-blown, मन्दाकिन्या of the Mandakini river, जलैरपि and by waters.
explanation: He saw the beauty created by radiant Karnikara forests, dense Kadamba groves, blooming lotus ponds, and the waters of the Mandakini river.

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमन्दारतरुभिस्तथा । चूतपाटललोध्रैश्च प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः । तगरैर्नारिकैलैश्च प्रियालपनसैस्तथा ।। 7.26.5 ।।
transliteration: campakāśokapunnāgamandāratarubhistathā | cūtapāṭalalodhraiśca priyaṅgvarjunaketakaiḥ | tagarairnārikailaiśca priyālapanasaistathā || 7.26.5 ||
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमन्दारतरुभिः by trees like Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, and Mandara, तथा and also, चूतपाटललोध्रैश्च and by Mango, Patala, and Lodhra trees, प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः by Priyangu, Arjuna, and Ketaka trees, तगरैः by Tagara trees, नारिकैलैश्च and by Narikela (coconut) trees, प्रियालपनसैः by Priyala and Panasa (jackfruit) trees, तथा and also.
explanation: The scene was further adorned by trees such as Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, Mandara, Mango, Patala, Lodhra, Priyangu, Arjuna, Ketaka, Tagara, Narikela, Priyala, and Panasa.

shloka_text: आरग्वधैस्तमालैश्च प्रियालवकुलैरपि । एतैरन्यैश्च तरुभिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे । किन्नरा मदनेनार्ता रक्ता मधुरकण्ठिनः ।। 7.26.6 ।।
transliteration: āragvadhaistamālaiśca priyālavakulairapi | etairanyaiśca tarubhirudbhāsitavanāntare | kinnarā madanenārtā raktā madhurakaṇṭhinaḥ || 7.26.6 ||
translation: आरग्वधैः by Aragvadha trees, तमालैश्च and by Tamala trees, प्रियालवकुलैरपि and also by Priyala and Bakula trees, एतैः by these, अन्यैश्च and by other, तरुभिः trees, उद्भासितवनान्तरे in the forest region made radiant, किन्नरा Kinnaras, मदनेनार्ता afflicted by love, रक्ता passionate, मधुरकण्ठिनः having sweet voices.
explanation: In that forest region, illuminated by these and other trees like Aragvadha, Tamala, Priyala, and Bakula, Kinnaras, tormented by love, sang passionately with their sweet voices.

shloka_text: समं सम्प्रजगुर्यत्र मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् ।। 7.26.7 ।।
transliteration: samaṃ samprajaguryatra manastuṣṭivivardhanam || 7.26.7 ||
translation: समं equally, सम्प्रजगुः they sang well, यत्र where, मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् increasing the satisfaction of the mind.
explanation: Where they sang together in unison, their songs greatly increased the satisfaction of the mind.

shloka_text: भिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे । विद्याधरा मदक्षीबा मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः । योषिद्भिः सह सङ्क्रान्ताश्चिक्रीडुर्जहृषुश्च वै ।। 7.26.8 ।।
transliteration: bhirudbhāsitavanāntare | vidyādharā madakṣībā madaraktāntalocanāḥ | yoṣidbhiḥ saha saṅkrāntāścikrīḍurjahṛṣuśca vai || 7.26.8 ||
translation: भिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे in the brightly lit forest interior, विद्याधराः Vidyadharas, मदक्षीबाः intoxicated, मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः with eyes red from intoxication, योषिद्भिः with women, सह together, सङ्क्रान्ताः having assembled, चिक्रीडुः they played, जहृषुः they rejoiced, च and, वै indeed.
explanation: In the brightly lit forest interior, the Vidyadharas, intoxicated and with eyes red from drink, assembled with their women and indeed played and rejoiced.

shloka_text: घण्टानामिव सन्नादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वरः । अप्सरोगणसङ्घानां गायतां धनदालये ।। 7.26.9 ।।
transliteration: ghaṇṭānāmiva sannādaḥ śuśruve madhurasvaraḥ | apsarogaṇasaṅghānāṃ gāyatāṃ dhanadālaye || 7.26.9 ||
translation: घण्टानाम् of bells, इव like, सन्नादः a sound, शुश्रुवे was heard, मधुरस्वरः a sweet sound, अप्सरोगणसङ्घानाम् of groups of Apsaras, गायताम् singing, धनदालये in the abode of Kubera.
explanation: In Kubera's abode, a sweet sound was heard, like the ringing of bells, from the singing groups of Apsaras.

shloka_text: पुष्पवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तो नगाः पवनताडिताः । शैलं तं वासयन्तीव मधुमाधवगन्धिनः ।। 7.26.10 ।।
transliteration: puṣpavarṣāṇi muñcanto nagāḥ pavanatāḍitāḥ | śailaṃ taṃ vāsayantīva madhumādhavagandhinaḥ || 7.26.10 ||
translation: पुष्पवर्षाणि showers of flowers, मुञ्चन्तः releasing, नगाः trees, पवनताडिताः struck by the wind, शैलम् the mountain, तम् that, वासयन्तीव as if perfuming, मधुमाधवगन्धिनः fragrant with the scent of spring flowers.
explanation: The trees, swayed by the wind, released showers of flowers, as if perfuming that mountain with the fragrance of spring blossoms.

shloka_text: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तं गन्धमादाय पुष्कलम् । प्रववौ वर्धयन्कामं रावणस्य सुखो ऽनिलः ।। 7.26.11 ।।
transliteration: madhupuṣparajaḥpṛktaṃ gandhamādāya puṣkalam | pravavau vardhayankāmaṃ rāvaṇasya sukho 'nilaḥ || 7.26.11 ||
translation: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तम् mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, गन्धम् fragrance, आदाय taking, पुष्कलम् abundant, प्रववौ blew, वर्धयन् increasing, कामम् desire, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुखः pleasant, अनिलः wind.
explanation: A pleasant wind blew, carrying the abundant fragrance mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, thereby increasing Ravana's desire.

shloka_text: गेयात्पुष्पसमृद्ध्या च शैत्याद्वायोर्गिरेर्गुणात् । प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां च चन्द्रस्योदयनेन च ।। 7.26.12 ।।
transliteration: geyātpuṣpasamṛddhyā ca śaityādvāyorgirerguṇāt | pravṛttāyāṃ rajanyāṃ ca candrasyodayanena ca || 7.26.12 ||
translation: गेयात् from singing, पुष्पसमृद्ध्या by the abundance of flowers, च and, शैत्यात् from the coolness, वायोः of the wind, गिरेः of the mountain, गुणात् from the quality, प्रवृत्तायाम् having begun, रजन्याम् in the night, च and, चन्द्रस्य of the moon, उदयनेन by the rising, च and.
explanation: The night had set in, enhanced by the melodious music, the profusion of flowers, the cool mountain breeze, and the rising of the moon.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु महावीर्यः कामस्य वशमागतः । विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य शशिनं समवैक्षत ।। 7.26.13 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryaḥ kāmasya vaśamāgataḥ | viniḥśvasya viniḥśvasya śaśinaṃ samavaikṣata || 7.26.13 ||
translation: रावणस्तु but Ravana, महावीर्यः of great valor, कामस्य of desire, वशम् under the sway, आगतः having come, विनिःश्वस्य sighing deeply, विनिःश्वस्य sighing deeply, शशिनम् at the moon, समवैक्षत looked intently.
explanation: Ravana, despite his great might, had fallen under the sway of desire and repeatedly sighed deeply as he gazed at the moon.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्याभरणभूषिता । सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता ।। 7.26.14 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare tatra divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | sarvāpsarovarā rambhā divyapuṣpavibhūṣitā || 7.26.14 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् at this, अन्तरे moment, तत्र there, दिव्याभरणभूषिता adorned with divine ornaments, सर्वाप्सरोवरा the best of all Apsaras, रम्भा Rambha, दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता adorned with divine flowers.
explanation: At that very moment, Rambha, the foremost of all Apsaras, appeared there, adorned with divine ornaments and divine flowers.

shloka_text: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा । दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना ।। 7.26.15 ।।
transliteration: divyacandanaliptāṅgī mandārakṛtamūrdhajā | divyotsavakṛtārambhā pūrṇacandranibhānanā || 7.26.15 ||
translation: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी whose limbs were smeared with divine sandalwood paste, मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा whose hair was adorned with Mandara flowers, दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा who had begun a divine celebration, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना whose face resembled the full moon.
explanation: Her body was smeared with divine sandalwood, her hair adorned with Mandara flowers, she had initiated a divine celebration, and her face shone like the full moon.

shloka_text: चक्षुर्मनोहरं पीनं मेखलादामभूषितम् । समुद्वहन्ती जघनं रतिप्राभृतमुत्तमम् ।। 7.26.16 ।।
transliteration: cakṣurmanoharaṃ pīnaṃ mekhalādāmabhūṣitam | samudvahantī jaghanaṃ ratiprābhṛtamuttamam || 7.26.16 ||
translation: चक्षुर्मनोहरम् charming to the eyes and mind, पीनम् plump, मेखलादामभूषितम् adorned with a girdle of bells, समुद्वहन्ती bearing, जघनम् hips, रतिप्राभृतम् a gift for love, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: She bore her hips, which were plump, charming to the eyes and mind, adorned with a girdle of bells, and an excellent offering for love.

shloka_text: कृतैर्विशेषकैरार्द्रैः षडर्तुकुसुमोद्भवैः ।। 7.26.17 ।।
transliteration: kṛtairviśeṣakairārdraiḥ ṣaḍartukusumodbhavaiḥ || 7.26.17 ||
translation: कृतैः made, विशेषकैः with special marks/decorations, आर्द्रैः fresh, षडर्तु of six seasons, कुसुम flowers, उद्भवैः produced from
explanation: She was adorned with fresh, special marks made from flowers of all six seasons.

shloka_text: बभावन्यतमेव श्रीकान्तिद्युतिमतिह्रियाम् । नीलं सतोयमेघाभं वस्त्रं समवकुण्ठिता ।। 7.26.18 ।।
transliteration: babhāvanyatameva śrīkāntidyutimatihriyām | nīlaṃ satoyameghābhaṃ vastraṃ samavakuṇṭhitā || 7.26.18 ||
translation: बभाव she appeared, अन्यतमेव as if another (form), श्री of beauty, कान्ति of splendor, द्युति of radiance, मति of intelligence, ह्रियाम् of modesty, नीलं blue, सतोय with water, मेघाभं cloud-like, वस्त्रं garment, समवकुण्ठिता covered
explanation: She appeared as if another embodiment of beauty, splendor, radiance, intelligence, and modesty, covered in a blue garment resembling a water-laden cloud.

shloka_text: यस्या वक्त्रं शशिनिभं भ्रुवौ चापनिभे शुभे । ऊरू करिकराकारौ करौ पल्लवकोमलौ । सैन्यमध्येन गच्छन्ती रावणेनोपवीक्षिता ।। 7.26.19 ।।
transliteration: yasyā vaktraṃ śaśinibhaṃ bhruvau cāpanibhe śubhe | ūrū karikarākārau karau pallavakomalau | sainyamadhyena gacchantī rāvaṇenopavīkṣitā || 7.26.19 ||
translation: यस्याः whose, वक्त्रं face, शशिनिभं moon-like, भ्रुवौ eyebrows, चापनिभे bow-like, शुभे beautiful, ऊरू thighs, करिकराकारौ elephant's trunk-like, करौ hands, पल्लवकोमलौ tender like sprouts, सैन्यमध्येन through the midst of the army, गच्छन्ती going, रावणेन by Ravana, उपवीक्षिता was seen
explanation: Her face was like the moon, her beautiful eyebrows like bows, her thighs like elephant trunks, and her hands soft as new leaves; as she walked through the army, she was observed by Ravana.

shloka_text: तां समुत्थाय गच्छन्तीं कामबाणवशं गतः । करे गृहीत्वा लज्जन्तीं स्मयमानो ऽभ्यभाषत ।। 7.26.20 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ samutthāya gacchantīṃ kāmabāṇavaśaṃ gataḥ | kare gṛhītvā lajjantīṃ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata || 7.26.20 ||
translation: तां her, समुत्थाय having risen, गच्छन्तीं going, कामबाणवशं under the sway of Cupid's arrows, गतः fallen, करे by the hand, गृहीत्वा having seized, लज्जन्तीं blushing, स्मयमानः smiling, अभ्यभाषत he spoke to
explanation: Having risen, Ravana, fallen under the sway of Cupid's arrows, seized her hand as she was going, and smiling, spoke to the blushing woman.

shloka_text: क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे कां सिद्धिं भजसे स्वयम् । कस्याभ्युदयकालो ऽयं यस्त्वां समुपभोक्ष्यते ।। 7.26.21 ।।
transliteration: kva gacchasi varārohe kāṃ siddhiṃ bhajase svayam | kasyābhyudayakālo 'yaṃ yastvāṃ samupabhokṣyate || 7.26.21 ||
translation: क्व where, गच्छसि you go, वरारोहे O lady with beautiful hips, कां what, सिद्धिं accomplishment, भजसे you seek, स्वयम् yourself, कस्य whose, अभ्युदयकालः time of prosperity, अयं this, यः who, त्वां you, समुपभोक्ष्यते will enjoy
explanation: "Where do you go, O lady of beautiful hips, what accomplishment do you seek for yourself, and whose time of prosperity is this, that he will enjoy you?"

shloka_text: त्वदाननरसस्याद्य पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः । सुधामृतरसस्येव को ऽद्य तृप्तिं गमिष्यति ।। 7.26.22 ।।
transliteration: tvadānanarasasyādya padmotpalasugandhinaḥ | sudhāmṛtarasasyeva ko 'dya tṛptiṃ gamiṣyati || 7.26.22 ||
translation: त्वदाननरसस्य of the essence of your face, अद्य today, पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः fragrant like lotus and water-lily, सुधामृतरसस्य of the essence of divine nectar, इव like, कः who, अद्य today, तृप्तिं satisfaction, गमिष्यति will attain.
explanation: Who today will ever be satisfied with the essence of your face, fragrant like lotuses and water-lilies, which is like the essence of divine nectar?

shloka_text: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ पीनौ शुभौ भीरु निरन्तरौ । कस्योरस्थलसंस्पर्शं दास्यतस्ते कुचाविमौ ।। 7.26.23 ।।
transliteration: svarṇakumbhanibhau pīnau śubhau bhīru nirantarau | kasyorasthalasaṃsparśaṃ dāsyataste kucāvimau || 7.26.23 ||
translation: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ resembling golden pitchers, पीनौ plump, शुभौ beautiful, भीरु O timid one, निरन्तरौ close-set, कस्य whose, उरस्थलसंस्पर्शं contact with the chest, दास्यतः will give, ते your, कुचाविमौ these two breasts.
explanation: O timid one, whose chest will these two plump, beautiful, close-set breasts of yours, resembling golden pitchers, touch?

shloka_text: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं स्वर्णदामचितं पृथु । अध्यारोहति कस्ते ऽद्य जघनं स्वर्गरूपिणम् ।। 7.26.24 ।।
transliteration: suvarṇacakrapratimaṃ svarṇadāmacitaṃ pṛthu | adhyārohati kaste 'dya jaghanaṃ svargarūpiṇam || 7.26.24 ||
translation: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं resembling a golden disc, स्वर्णदामचितं adorned with golden chains, पृथु broad, अध्यारोहति will ascend, कः who, ते your, अद्य today, जघनं hips, स्वर्गरूपिणम् having the form of heaven.
explanation: Who today will ascend your broad hips, which resemble a golden disc, are adorned with golden chains, and are like heaven itself?

shloka_text: मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्को ऽद्य शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ । मामतीत्य हि यं च त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम् ।। 7.26.25 ।।
transliteration: madviśiṣṭaḥ pumānko 'dya śakro viṣṇurathāśvinau | māmatītya hi yaṃ ca tvaṃ yāsi bhīru na śobhanam || 7.26.25 ||
translation: मद्विशिष्टः superior to me, पुमान् man, कः who, अद्य today, शक्रः Indra, विष्णुः Vishnu, अथ or, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, माम् me, अतीत्य surpassing, हि indeed, यं whom, च and, त्वं you, यासि go, भीरु O timid one, न not, शोभनम् proper.
explanation: Who is that man superior to me today, be it Indra, Vishnu, or the Ashvins, whom you, O timid one, would go to, leaving me behind, for that would not be proper?

shloka_text: विश्रम त्वं पृथुश्रोणि शिलातलमिदं शुभम् ।। 7.26.26 ।।
transliteration: viśrama tvaṃ pṛthuśroṇi śilātalamidaṃ śubham || 7.26.26 ||
translation: विश्रम rest, त्वं you, पृथुश्रोणि O broad-hipped one, शिलातलम् rock surface, इदं this, शुभम् beautiful.
explanation: O broad-hipped one, you should rest on this beautiful rock surface.

shloka_text: त्रैलोक्ये यः प्रभुश्चैव मदन्यो नैव विद्यते ।। 7.26.27 ।।
transliteration: trailokye yaḥ prabhuścaiva madanyo naiva vidyate || 7.26.27 ||
translation: त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यः who, प्रभुः lord, च and, एव indeed, मदन्यः other than me, न not, एव indeed, विद्यते exists.
explanation: There is no lord in the three worlds other than me.

shloka_text: तदेवं प्राञ्जलिः प्रह्वो याचते त्वां दशाननः । भर्तुर्भर्ता विधाता च त्रैलोक्यस्य भजस्व माम् ।। 7.26.28 ।।
transliteration: tadevaṃ prāñjaliḥ prahvo yācate tvāṃ daśānanaḥ | bharturbhartā vidhātā ca trailokyasya bhajasva mām || 7.26.28 ||
translation: तत् therefore, एवम् thus, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रह्वः bowed down, याचते begs, त्वाम् you, दशाननः the ten-headed one (Ravana), भर्तुः of the husband, भर्ता the husband (lord), विधाता the creator, च and, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, भजस्व worship, माम् me.
explanation: Therefore, the ten-headed Ravana, bowing down with folded hands, begs you, "Worship me, for I am the lord of lords and the creator of the three worlds."

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता ऽब्रवीद्रम्भा वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः । प्रसीद नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशं त्वं हि मे गुरुः ।। 7.26.29 ।।
transliteration: evamuktā 'bravīdrambhā vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ | prasīda nārhase vaktumīdṛśaṃ tvaṃ hi me guruḥ || 7.26.29 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, अब्रवीत् said, रम्भा Rambha, वेपमाना trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रसीद be pleased (have mercy), न not, अर्हसे you ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such a thing, त्वम् you, हि indeed, मे my, गुरुः elder/revered one.
explanation: Thus addressed, Rambha, trembling and with folded hands, replied, "Please have mercy; you should not speak such words, for you are indeed like an elder to me."

shloka_text: अन्येभ्यो हि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि । तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा ते ऽहं तत्त्वमेव ब्रवीमि ते ।। 7.26.30 ।।
transliteration: anyebhyo hi tvayā rakṣyā prāpnuyāṃ dharṣaṇaṃ yadi | taddharmataḥ snuṣā te 'haṃ tattvameva bravīmi te || 7.26.30 ||
translation: अन्येभ्यः from others, हि indeed, त्वया by you, रक्ष्या to be protected, प्राप्नुयाम् I might obtain, धर्षणम् molestation/violation, यदि if, तत् therefore, धर्मतः by dharma/righteously, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, ते your, अहम् I, तत्त्वम् the truth, एव indeed, ब्रवीमि I tell, ते to you.
explanation: You are indeed the one who should protect me from molestation by others, and by dharma, I am your daughter-in-law; I tell you this truth.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवश्चरणाधोमुखीं स्थिताम् । रोमहर्षमनुप्राप्तां दृष्टमात्रेण तां तदा ।। 7.26.31 ।।
transliteration: athābravīddaśagrīvaścaraṇādhomukhīṃ sthitām | romaharṣamanuprāptāṃ dṛṣṭamātreṇa tāṃ tadā || 7.26.31 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः the ten-necked one (Ravana), चरणाधोमुखीम् with face turned downwards towards the feet, स्थिताम् standing, रोमहर्षम् goosebumps/horripilation, अनुप्राप्ताम् having obtained, दृष्टमात्रेण by merely seeing, ताम् her, तदा then.
explanation: Then Ravana spoke to her, who was standing with her face turned downwards towards his feet, having gotten goosebumps merely upon seeing him.

shloka_text: सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं हि स्नुषा भवेः । बाढमित्येव सा रम्भा प्राह रावणमुत्तरम् ।। 7.26.32 ।।
transliteration: sutasya yadi me bhāryā tatastvaṃ hi snuṣā bhaveḥ | bāḍhamityeva sā rambhā prāha rāvaṇamuttaram || 7.26.32 ||
translation: सुतस्य of the son, यदि if, मे my, भार्या wife, ततस् then, त्वं you, हि indeed, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, भवेः would be, बाढम् "Indeed", इति एव thus, सा she, रम्भा Rambha, प्राह said, रावणम् to Ravana, उत्तरम् in reply.
explanation: Rambha replied to Ravana, saying, "If I were the wife of your son, then you would indeed be my father-in-law."

shloka_text: धर्मतस्ते सुतस्याहं भार्या राक्षसपुङ्गव । पुत्रः प्रियतरः प्राणैर्भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य ते । विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु नलकूबर इत्ययम् ।। 7.26.33 ।।
transliteration: dharmataste sutasyāhaṃ bhāryā rākṣasapuṅgava | putraḥ priyataraḥ prāṇairbhrāturvaiśravaṇasya te | vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu nalakūbara ityayam || 7.26.33 ||
translation: धर्मतस् by religious law, ते your, सुतस्य of the son, अहम् I, भार्या wife, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas, पुत्रः son, प्रियतरः dearer, प्राणैः than life, भ्रातुः of the brother, वैश्रवणस्य of Vaishravana (Kubera), ते your, विख्यातस् renowned, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, नलकूबरः Nalakubara, इति अयम् thus this one.
explanation: O best of Rakshasas, I am rightfully the wife of your son, Nalakubara, who is dearer to your brother Vaishravana (Kubera) than life itself and is renowned in all three worlds.

shloka_text: धर्मतो यो भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो वीर्यतो भवेत् । क्रोधाद्यश्च भवेदग्निः क्षान्त्या च वसुधासमः ।। 7.26.34 ।।
transliteration: dharmato yo bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo vīryato bhavet | krodhādyaśca bhavedagniḥ kṣāntyā ca vasudhāsamaḥ || 7.26.34 ||
translation: धर्मतस् by righteousness, यः who, भवेत् would be, विप्रः a Brahmin, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, वीर्यतस् by valor, भवेत् would be, क्रोधात् from anger, यः च and who, भवेत् would be, अग्निः fire, क्षान्त्या by patience, च and, वसुधासमः equal to the earth.
explanation: He (Nalakubara) is like a Brahmin by righteousness, a Kshatriya by valor, fire by his anger, and equal to the earth in patience.

shloka_text: तस्यास्मि कृतसङ्केता लोकपालसुतस्य वै । तमुद्दिश्य तु मे सर्वं विभूषणमिदं कृतम् ।। 7.26.35 ।।
transliteration: tasyāsmi kṛtasaṅketā lokapālasutasya vai | tamuddiśya tu me sarvaṃ vibhūṣaṇamidaṃ kṛtam || 7.26.35 ||
translation: तस्य of him, अस्मि I am, कृतसङ्केता one who has made a promise, लोकपालसुतस्य of the son of a Lokapala, वै indeed, तम् him, उद्दिश्य intending, तु but, मे my, सर्वम् all, विभूषणम् ornaments, इदम् this, कृतम् made.
explanation: I am indeed promised to him, the son of a Lokapala, and all these ornaments I wear are for his sake.

shloka_text: तथा तस्य हि नान्यस्य भावो मां प्रति तिष्ठति ।। 7.26.36 ।।
transliteration: tathā tasya hi nānyasya bhāvo māṃ prati tiṣṭhati || 7.26.36 ||
translation: तथा thus, तस्य of him, हि indeed, न not, अन्यस्य of another, भावः feeling, माम् me, प्रति towards, तिष्ठति exists.
explanation: Thus, my affection is indeed for him alone, and not for anyone else.

shloka_text: तेन सत्येन मां राजन्मोक्तुमर्हस्यरिन्दम ।। 7.26.37 ।।
transliteration: tena satyena māṃ rājanmoktumarhasyarindama || 7.26.37 ||
translation: तेन by that, सत्येन truth, माम् me, राजन् O king, मोक्तुम् to release, अर्हसि you ought, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies
explanation: O King, destroyer of enemies, by that truth, you ought to release me.

shloka_text: स हि तिष्ठति धर्मात्मा मां प्रतीक्ष्य समुत्सुकः । तत्र विघ्नं सुतस्येह कर्तुं नार्हसि मुञ्च माम् ।। 7.26.38 ।।
transliteration: sa hi tiṣṭhati dharmātmā māṃ pratīkṣya samutsukaḥ | tatra vighnaṃ sutasyeha kartuṃ nārhasi muñca mām || 7.26.38 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, तिष्ठति waits, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, माम् me, प्रतीक्ष्य waiting for, समुत्सुकः very eager, तत्र there, विघ्नम् an obstacle, सुतस्य for the son, इह here, कर्तुम् to create, न not, अर्हसि you ought, मुञ्च release, माम् me
explanation: Indeed, that righteous one waits for me, very eager; you ought not to create an obstacle for your son in this matter, so release me.

shloka_text: सद्भिराचरितं मार्गं गच्छ राक्षसुपुङ्गव । माननीयो मम त्वं हि पालनीया तथा ऽस्मि ते ।। 7.26.39 ।।
transliteration: sadbhirācaritaṃ mārgaṃ gaccha rākṣasupuṅgava | mānanīyo mama tvaṃ hi pālanīyā tathā 'smi te || 7.26.39 ||
translation: सद्भिः by the good people, आचरितम् practiced, मार्गम् path, गच्छ follow, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas, माननीयः worthy of respect, मम to me, त्वम् you, हि indeed, पालनीया to be protected, तथा similarly, अस्मि I am, ते by you
explanation: O best of Rakshasas, follow the path practiced by the good; you are indeed worthy of respect to me, and I am similarly to be protected by you.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत् । स्नुषा ऽस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः । देवलोकस्थितिरियं सुराणां शाश्वती मता ।। 7.26.40 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ pratyuvāca vinītavat | snuṣā 'smi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṃ kramaḥ | devalokasthitiriyaṃ surāṇāṃ śāśvatī matā || 7.26.40 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रत्युवाच replied, विनीतवत् as if humbly, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, अस्मि I am, यत् that which, अवोचः you said, त्वम् you, एकपत्नीषु among those with one husband, अयम् this, क्रमः custom, देवलोकस्थितिः the custom of the divine world, इयम् this, सुराणाम् of the gods, शाश्वती eternal, मता considered
explanation: Thus addressed, Dashagriva replied as if humbly, saying that what she spoke about being a daughter-in-law and the custom of having one husband applies only to women with a single spouse, and that this custom of the divine world for gods is considered eternal.

shloka_text: पतिरप्सरसां नास्ति न चैकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः ।। 7.26.41 ।।
transliteration: patirapsarasāṃ nāsti na caikastrīparigrahaḥ || 7.26.41 ||
translation: पतिः husband, अप्सरसाम् of Apsaras, न not, अस्ति exists, न nor, च and, एकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः the custom of having one wife
explanation: There is no single husband for Apsaras, nor is there a custom of having only one wife.

shloka_text: अस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः । एवमुक्त्वा स तां रक्षो निवेश्य च शिलातले । कामभोगाभिसंसक्तो मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.26.42 ।।
transliteration: asmi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṃ kramaḥ | evamuktvā sa tāṃ rakṣo niveśya ca śilātale | kāmabhogābhisaṃsakto maithunāyopacakrame || 7.26.42 ||
translation: अस्मि I am, यत् what, अवोचः you said, त्वम् you, एकपत्नीषु among chaste wives, अयम् this, क्रमः rule, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, सः he, ताम् her, रक्षः the demon, निवेश्य having placed, च and, शिलातले on a rock surface, कामभोगाभिसंसक्तः deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, मैथुनाय for sexual union, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having said, "I am what you said, this is the rule among chaste wives," the demon Ravana, deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, placed her on a rock surface and proceeded to engage in sexual union.

shloka_text: सा विमुक्ता ततो रम्भा भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा । गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता नदीवाकुलतां गता ।। 7.26.43 ।।
transliteration: sā vimuktā tato rambhā bhraṣṭamālyavibhūṣaṇā | gajendrākrīḍamathitā nadīvākulatāṃ gatā || 7.26.43 ||
translation: सा she, विमुक्ता released, ततः then, रम्भा Rambha, भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा with fallen garlands and ornaments, गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता churned by the sport of a lordly elephant, नदी a river, इव like, आकुलताम् agitation, गता attained.
explanation: Rambha, thus released, with her garlands and ornaments fallen, became agitated like a river churned by the sport of a lordly elephant.

shloka_text: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता करवेपितपल्लवा । पवनेनावधूतेव लता कुसुमशालिनी ।। 7.26.44 ।।
transliteration: lulitākulakeśāntā karavepitapallavā | pavanenāvadhūteva latā kusumaśālinī || 7.26.44 ||
translation: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता with disheveled and scattered hair, करवेपितपल्लवा with trembling hands (like trembling sprouts), पवनेन by the wind, अवधूता shaken, इव like, लता a creeper, कुसुमशालिनी adorned with flowers.
explanation: Her hair was disheveled and scattered, and her hands trembled like sprouts, resembling a flower-laden creeper shaken by the wind.

shloka_text: सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः । नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोर्निपपात ह ।। 7.26.45 ।।
transliteration: sā vepamānā lajjantī bhītā karakṛtāñjaliḥ | nalakūbaramāsādya pādayornipapāta ha || 7.26.45 ||
translation: सा she, वेपमाना trembling, लज्जन्ती feeling ashamed, भीता frightened, करकृताञ्जलिः with hands joined in supplication, नलकूबरम् Nalakubara, आसाद्य having approached, पादयोः at the feet, निपपात fell down, ह indeed.
explanation: Trembling, ashamed, and frightened, she approached Nalakubara with folded hands and fell at his feet.

shloka_text: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः । अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतिता ऽसि मे ।। 7.26.46 ।।
transliteration: tadavasthāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmā nalakūbaraḥ | abravītkimidaṃ bhadre pādayoḥ patitā 'si me || 7.26.46 ||
translation: तत् that, अवस्थाम् state, च and, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महात्मा the great-souled, नलकूबरः Nalakubara, अब्रवीत् said, किम् what, इदम् this, भद्रे O gentle one, पादयोः at the feet, पतिता fallen, असि you are, मे my.
explanation: Seeing her in that state, the great-souled Nalakubara asked, "O gentle one, what is this, that you have fallen at my feet?"

shloka_text: सा वै निःश्वसमाना तु वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः । तस्मै सर्वं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.26.47 ।।
transliteration: sā vai niḥśvasamānā tu vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ | tasmai sarvaṃ yathātattvamākhyātumupacakrame || 7.26.47 ||
translation: सा she, वै indeed, निःश्वसमाना sighing deeply, तु and, वेपमाना trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, तस्मै to him, सर्वं all, यथातत्त्वम् as it truly happened, आख्यातुम् to narrate, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Trembling and sighing deeply, she, with folded hands, began to narrate everything to him exactly as it had happened.

shloka_text: एष देव दशग्रीवः प्राप्तो गन्तुं त्रिविष्टपम् । तेन सैन्यसहायेन निशेयं परिणामिता ।। 7.26.48 ।।
transliteration: eṣa deva daśagrīvaḥ prāpto gantuṃ triviṣṭapam | tena sainyasahāyena niśeyaṃ pariṇāmitā || 7.26.48 ||
translation: एष this, देव O god, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्राप्तः arrived, गन्तुम् to go, त्रिविष्टपम् to heaven, तेन by him, सैन्यसहायेन with the help of his army, निशा इयम् this night, परिणामिता was passed.
explanation: O god, this Dashagriva arrived here to go to heaven, and with the help of his army, he spent this night.

shloka_text: आयन्ती तेन दृष्टा ऽस्मि त्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम । गृहीता तेन पृष्टा ऽस्मि कस्य त्वमिति रक्षसा ।। 7.26.49 ।।
transliteration: āyantī tena dṛṣṭā 'smi tvatsakāśamarindama | gṛhītā tena pṛṣṭā 'smi kasya tvamiti rakṣasā || 7.26.49 ||
translation: आयन्ती while coming, तेन by him, दृष्टा seen, अस्मि I am, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies, गृहीता seized, तेन by him, पृष्टा asked, अस्मि I am, कस्य whose, त्वम् you, इति thus, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa.
explanation: O destroyer of enemies, I was seen by him while coming to your presence, and I was seized and asked by that Rakshasa, "Whose are you?"

shloka_text: मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तस्मै सर्वं निवेदितम् । काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषीत्तद्वचो मम ।। 7.26.50 ।।
transliteration: mayā tu sarvaṃ yatsatyaṃ tasmai sarvaṃ niveditam | kāmamohābhibhūtātmā nāśrauṣīttadvaco mama || 7.26.50 ||
translation: मया by me, तु but, सर्वं all, यत् सत्यम् which was true, तस्मै to him, सर्वं all, निवेदितम् was reported, काममोहाभिभूतात्मा whose mind was overcome by lust and delusion, न not, अश्रौषीत् heard, तत् that, वचः word, मम my.
explanation: But I reported everything truly to him, yet his mind, overcome by lust and delusion, did not listen to my words.

shloka_text: याच्यमानो मया देव स्नुषा ते ऽहमिति प्रभो । तत्सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा बलात्तेनास्मि धर्षिता ।। 7.26.51 ।।
transliteration: yācyamāno mayā deva snuṣā te 'hamiti prabho | tatsarvaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā balāttenāsmi dharṣitā || 7.26.51 ||
translation: याच्यमानः being implored, मया by me, देव O god, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, ते your, अहम् I, इति thus, प्रभो O lord, तत् सर्वम् all that, पृष्ठतः कृत्वा having put aside, बलात् by force, तेन by him, अस्मि I am, धर्षिता violated.
explanation: O god, O lord, despite being implored by me that I am your daughter-in-law, he disregarded all that and forcibly violated me.

shloka_text: एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत । न हि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य च ।। 7.26.52 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ tvamaparādhaṃ me kṣantumarhasi suvrata | na hi tulyaṃ balaṃ saumya striyāśca puruṣasya ca || 7.26.52 ||
translation: एवम् thus, त्वम् you, अपराधम् offense, मे my, क्षन्तुम् to forgive, अर्हसि ought, सुव्रत O one of good vows, न not, हि indeed, तुल्यम् equal, बलम् strength, सौम्य O gentle one, स्त्रियाः of a woman, च and, पुरुषस्य of a man, च and,
explanation: O virtuous and gentle one, you ought to forgive my offense, for indeed, the strength of a woman and a man is not equal.

shloka_text: एतछुत्वा तु सङ्क्रुद्धस्तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः । धर्षणां तां परां श्रुत्वा ध्यानं सम्प्रविवेश ह ।। 7.26.53 ।।
transliteration: etachutvā tu saṅkruddhastadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ | dharṣaṇāṃ tāṃ parāṃ śrutvā dhyānaṃ sampraviveśa ha || 7.26.53 ||
translation: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, तदा then, वैश्रवणात्मजः the son of Vaishravana, धर्षणाम् outrage, ताम् that, पराम् extreme, श्रुत्वा having heard, ध्यानम् deep thought, सम्प्रविवेश entered completely, ह indeed,
explanation: Having heard this, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) became greatly enraged and, upon hearing of that extreme outrage, he entered into deep contemplation.

shloka_text: तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः । मुहूर्तात्क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना ।। 7.26.54 ।।
transliteration: tasya tatkarma vijñāya tadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ | muhūrtātkrodhatāmrākṣastoyaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā || 7.26.54 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, कर्म deed, विज्ञाय having understood, तदा then, वैश्रवणात्मजः the son of Vaishravana, मुहूर्तात् in a moment, क्रोधताम्राक्षः with eyes red from anger, तोयम् water, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand,
explanation: Having understood that deed of his, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) instantly, with eyes red from anger, took water in his hand.

shloka_text: गृहीत्वा सलिलं सर्वमुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि । उत्ससर्ज यथा शापं राक्षसेन्द्राय दारुणम् ।। 7.26.55 ।।
transliteration: gṛhītvā salilaṃ sarvamupaspṛśya yathāvidhi | utsasarja yathā śāpaṃ rākṣasendrāya dāruṇam || 7.26.55 ||
translation: गृहीत्वा having taken, सलिलम् water, सर्वम् all, उपस्पृश्य having touched, यथाविधि according to the ritual, उत्ससर्ज he released, यथा as, शापम् a curse, राक्षसेन्द्राय to the king of Rakshasas, दारुणम् terrible,
explanation: Having taken the water and performed the ritual purification, he then uttered a terrible curse upon the king of Rakshasas (Ravana).

shloka_text: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता । तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति ।। 7.26.56 ।।
transliteration: akāmā tena yasmāttvaṃ balādbhadre pradharṣitā | tasmātsa yuvatīmanyāṃ nākāmāmupayāsyati || 7.26.56 ||
translation: अकामा unwilling, तेन by him, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, बलात् by force, भद्रे O auspicious one, प्रधर्षिता molested, तस्मात् therefore, सः he, युवतीम् a young woman, अन्याम् another, न not, अकामाम् unwilling, उपयास्यति will approach,
explanation: O auspicious one, because you were molested by him by force against your will, therefore he will not approach another young woman who is unwilling.

shloka_text: यदा ह्यकामां कामार्तो धर्षयिष्यति योषितम् । मूर्धा तु सप्तधा तस्य शकलीभविता तदा ।। 7.26.57 ।।
transliteration: yadā hyakāmāṃ kāmārto dharṣayiṣyati yoṣitam | mūrdhā tu saptadhā tasya śakalībhavitā tadā || 7.26.57 ||
translation: यदा when, हि indeed, अकामां an unwilling, कामार्तः lust-struck, धर्षयिष्यति will violate, योषितम् a woman, मूर्धा head, तु but, सप्तधा into seven parts, तस्य his, शकलीभविता will be shattered, तदा then.
explanation: When a lust-struck man violates an unwilling woman, his head will indeed shatter into seven pieces.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता । पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः ।। 7.26.58 ।।
transliteration: tasminnudāhṛte śāpe jvalitāgnisamaprabhe | devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca khāccyutā | pitāmahamukhāścaiva sarve devāḥ praharṣitāḥ || 7.26.58 ||
translation: तस्मिन् upon that, उदाहृते having been uttered, शापे curse, ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे shining like a blazing fire, देवदुन्दुभयः divine drums, नेदुः resounded, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, च and, खात् from the sky, च्युता fell, पितामहमुखाः led by Brahma, च and, एव indeed, सर्वे all, देवाः gods, प्रहर्षिताः greatly delighted.
explanation: Upon the utterance of that curse, which shone like a blazing fire, divine drums resounded, a shower of flowers fell from the sky, and all the gods, led by Brahma, were greatly delighted.

shloka_text: ज्ञात्वा लोकगतिं सर्वां तस्य मृत्युं च रक्षसः । ऋषयः पितरश्चैव प्रीतिमापुरनुत्तमाम् ।। 7.26.59 ।।
transliteration: jñātvā lokagatiṃ sarvāṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ ca rakṣasaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaiva prītimāpuranuttamām || 7.26.59 ||
translation: ज्ञात्वा having known, लोकगतिं the course of the world, सर्वां all, तस्य his, मृत्युं death, च and, रक्षसः of the demon, ऋषयः sages, पितरः ancestors, च and, एव indeed, प्रीतिम् joy, आपुः attained, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed.
explanation: Understanding the entire course of the world and the demon's impending death, the sages and ancestors indeed experienced unsurpassed joy.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु स दशग्रीवस्तं शापं रोमहर्षणम् । नारीषु मैथुने भावं नाकामास्वभ्यरोचयत् ।। 7.26.60 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu sa daśagrīvastaṃ śāpaṃ romaharṣaṇam | nārīṣu maithune bhāvaṃ nākāmāsvabhyarocayat || 7.26.60 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु but, स he, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तं that, शापं curse, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, नारीषु among women, मैथुने in sexual intercourse, भावं inclination, न not, अकामासु unwilling, अभ्यरोचयत् he approved.
explanation: But having heard that terrifying, hair-raising curse, Dashagriva no longer desired sexual intimacy with unwilling women.

shloka_text: तेन नीताः स्त्रियः प्रीतिमापुः सर्वाः पतिव्रताः । नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं शापं श्रुत्वा मनःप्रियम् ।। 7.26.61 ।।
transliteration: tena nītāḥ striyaḥ prītimāpuḥ sarvāḥ pativratāḥ | nalakūbaranirmuktaṃ śāpaṃ śrutvā manaḥpriyam || 7.26.61 ||
translation: तेन by that, नीताः taken, स्त्रियः women, प्रीतिम् joy, आपुः attained, सर्वाः all, पतिव्रताः chaste, नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं uttered by Nalakubara, शापं curse, श्रुत्वा having heard, मनःप्रियम् pleasing to the mind.
explanation: All the chaste women who had been abducted by him attained great joy upon hearing that delightful curse uttered by Nalakubara. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षड्वविंशः सर्गः ।। 26 ।। Thus ends the twenty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
